newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 29.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 29.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to major shipping on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
Pacific beach town port Puerto Escondido was closed to tourism and fishing boats because of high waves, the report said.
A new tropical storm in the Pacific sparked thunder storms in Colima and Nayarit. Electric storms also forecast for Oaxaca and Chiapas states.
Rains expected in the evening along Veracruz and Tabasco, with clear skies seen in the remainder of the Gulf of Mexico.
